input.rationale: Section 21 is mutual in form and carries a full Excluded Claims set in 21.3 (confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other Party's IP), and 21.2 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually. The cap quantum, however, is illusory: "Fees" is defined at 1.5 as only the Implementation Fee, fixed by 1.6 as a one-time USD 12,000 under the first Order Form, and 21.1 further restricts the basis to that first Order Form. That is well below six months' fees and so fails the fallback element requiring a cap based on 12 months of fees. Our single edit restates the quantum as the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, keeping the existing temporal anchor and every carve-out verbatim; "and all Order Forms" is needed to displace the retained "first Order Form" restriction, and lowercase "fees" is used in its ordinary sense so the defined term continues to operate unchanged in 21.3 and elsewhere. We note (not flagged) that the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor is absent and that 21.3's payment carve-out is limited to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" rather than Customer's payment obligations generally.

proposal.summary: Cap set at twelve (12) months of fees under the Agreement and all Order Forms
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap is tied to defined "Fees" (the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) under the first Order Form only, so it is illusory; we set it at the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, per our fallback position. Indemnities, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct remain uncapped as Excluded Claims.
